name: Gambia
summary_text: Gambia is dangerous for trans visitors. There is no LGR and no visible community.

sources.title: Gambia | Outright International
sources.claim_summary: Outright International country overview (updated March 2026): Gambia has criminalised same-sex conduct since the colonial era; the 2014 amendment introduced 'aggravated homosexuality' (life imprisonment) under Jammeh, who threatened to 'decapitate' gay people. A new criminal code (March 2025) removes 'aggravated homosexuality' but sets a minimum of five years for 'unnatural offences' (defined as 'any homosexual act') and three years for 'gross indecency', with no maximum - so any same-sex act could in theory draw life. The Barrow government has not typically enforced.

sources.title: Gambia increases minimum sentence for homosexual acts to 5 Years - WADR
sources.claim_summary: West Africa Democracy Radio: 'Gambia increases minimum sentence for homosexual acts to 5 Years' — reports the new criminal-law package raising the minimum sentence for same-sex acts to five years.

sources.title: The Gambia: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report | Freedom House
sources.claim_summary: Freedom House Freedom in the World 2024 for The Gambia: 'Partly Free' (50/100); freedoms improved under Barrow after 22 years of Jammeh's rule, but LGBT+ people face severe discrimination among ongoing concerns.

UK Home Office CPIN Gambia: Sexual orientation and gender identity or expression (v3.0, Feb 2023): assessment of risk, protection, internal relocation and certification for LGBT+ asylum claims, with detailed country information on law and treatment.
HRW report (Sept 2015) 'State of Fear': arbitrary arrests, torture and killings in Gambia under Jammeh - includes the context of his anti-gay rhetoric and threats against LGBT people.

sources.title: Gambia, The - United States Department of State
sources.claim_summary: US State Department 2020 Human Rights Report for Gambia: official assessment - same-sex conduct criminalised (up to life imprisonment under the 2013 amendment); documents arrests and societal discrimination.

sources.title: Gambia, The - United States Department of State
sources.claim_summary: US State Department 2021 Human Rights Report for Gambia: official assessment - continued criminalisation, no prosecutions reported, significant societal stigma and police harassment of LGBT persons.
